tool_schemas.name: list_laravel_docs
tool_schemas.description: Lists documentation entries available in the local cache, optionally filtered to a single Laravel version, and returns the matching filenames/paths for discovery. Results are returned as a single unpaged list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the version format is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the requested version is not present in the cache, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to the documentation index is not permitted.

tool_schemas.name: search_laravel_docs
tool_schemas.description: Runs a full-text search for the required query across cached Laravel docs and, when include_external is true, supported external Laravel service docs; returns matching documents with per-document hit counts. Results are returned as a single unpaged list for the selected scope (optionally restricted by version). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty/invalid query or invalid version, NOT_FOUND when a specific version is requested but not cached, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if searching is not permitted.

tool_schemas.name: update_laravel_docs
tool_schemas.description: Syncs documentation from upstream sources into the local versioned cache for the requested version (or the default set when version is null) and returns a summary of what was updated; when force is true, it re-syncs even if the cache appears current. This operation is not paged and returns one update result per version/source processed. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid version, FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you are not allowed to run sync operations, CONFLICT if an update is already in progress for the same target, and NOT_FOUND if a specific requested version cannot be resolved or synced from supported sources.

tool_schemas.name: laravel_docs_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns metadata about the cached documentation set (or a specific version), including last sync/update timestamps and upstream commit identifiers when available. The response is a single object (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid version, NOT_FOUND if the requested version has no cached metadata, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to documentation state is not permitted.

tool_schemas.name: get_laravel_package_recommendations
tool_schemas.description: Returns a curated set of package recommendations based on the provided use_case text, including suggested packages and rationale aligned to the catalog’s categories. Results are returned as a single unpaged list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if use_case is missing/blank, FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to recommendations is not permitted, and NOT_FOUND if no recommendations can be produced from the current catalog.

tool_schemas.name: get_laravel_package_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns the catalog record for the requested package_name, including a normalized name, description, installation/usage notes when available, and any assigned categories. The response is a single object (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if package_name is missing/blank, NOT_FOUND if the package is not in the curated catalog, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to package details is not permitted.

tool_schemas.name: get_laravel_package_categories
tool_schemas.description: Lists all catalog packages that belong to the required category and returns their basic details for comparison/discovery. Results are returned as a single unpaged list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if category is missing/blank, NOT_FOUND if the category does not exist or contains no packages in the catalog, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to the package catalog is not permitted.

tool_schemas.name: get_features_for_laravel_package
tool_schemas.description: Returns common implementation features/patterns associated with the requested package from the curated catalog (for example, typical use cases, integration points, and recommended setup steps when available). The response is a single object or feature list (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if package is missing/blank, NOT_FOUND if the package is not in the catalog or has no feature entry, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to package feature details is not permitted.

tool_schemas.name: read_laravel_doc_content
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns the full text content for a specific documentation file identified by filename, optionally within a specific version. The response is a single document (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filename is missing/blank or version is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the version or file does not exist in the local cache, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you are not allowed to read documentation content.

tool_schemas.name: search_laravel_docs_with_context
tool_schemas.description: Runs a full-text search for query across cached docs (and optionally external docs) and returns matches along with a context snippet around each hit, sized by context_length. Results are returned as a single unpaged list for the selected scope (optionally restricted by version). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty/invalid query, invalid version, or non-positive/invalid context_length, NOT_FOUND when a specific version is requested but not cached, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if searching or reading snippets is not permitted.

tool_schemas.name: get_doc_structure
tool_schemas.description: Returns the parsed structure for a single documentation file (by filename) including its sections/headings for the requested version, falling back to the default synced version when version is null. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filename is empty/invalid or version is not supported, NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist for that version, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to read documentation.

tool_schemas.name: browse_docs_by_category
tool_schemas.description: Lists documentation entries within a given category for the requested version (or the default synced version when version is null) and returns the category’s documents/sections in browse order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if category is empty/unknown or version is not supported, NOT_FOUND if the category has no documents for that version, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to browse documentation.

tool_schemas.name: update_external_laravel_docs
tool_schemas.description: Syncs and updates the locally-cached documentation for supported external Laravel services (Forge/Vapor/Envoyer/Nova, etc.) and returns a per-service result (updated/skipped/error) along with sync metadata; when services is null it targets all services, and force=true re-fetches even if sources appear up to date. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any requested service key is unknown, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks sync privileges, CONFLICT if a sync job for the same service(s) is already in progress, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS if sync quotas or upstream rate limits are exceeded.
tool_schemas.implementation:
def update_external_laravel_docs(services=None, force=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, hashlib, re

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0390000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0390000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    _CROCKFORD = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"

    def _ulid():
        # Best-effort ULID (time sortable). No external deps.
        ts_ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
        # 48-bit timestamp -> 10 chars base32
        v = ts_ms & ((1 << 48) - 1)
        tchars = []
        for _ in range(10):
            tchars.append(_CROCKFORD[v & 31])
            v >>= 5
        t = "".join(reversed(tchars))
        # 80-bit randomness -> 16 chars base32
        rb = os.urandom(10)
        r = int.from_bytes(rb, "big")
        rchars = []
        for _ in range(16):
            rchars.append(_CROCKFORD[r & 31])
            r >>= 5
        return t + "".join(reversed(rchars))

    # ---- Validation ----
    if force is None:
        force = False
    if not isinstance(force, bool):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "force must be a boolean")
    if services is not None:
        if not isinstance(services, list) or any(not isinstance(s, str) for s in services):
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "services must be an array of strings or null")
        # normalize, reject empties
        norm = []
        for s in services:
            ss = s.strip()
            if not ss:
                return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "services contains an empty key")
            norm.append(ss)
        services = norm

    # ---- Load store ----
    t0 = time.time()
    doc_sources = _load("doc_sources.json")
    doc_files = _load("doc_files.json")
    sync_jobs = _load("sync_jobs.json")

    # ---- Resolve target service sources ----
    service_sources = [r for r in doc_sources if r.get("source_type") == "service"]
    if services is None:
        targets = [r for r in service_sources if r.get("status") in ("active", "error", "disabled")]
        requested_keys = None
    else:
        # Validate unknown keys (per tool description)
        known_keys = {r.get("key") for r in service_sources}
        unknown = [k for k in services if k not in known_keys]
        if unknown:
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Unknown service key(s)", unknown_keys=unknown)
        targets = [r for r in service_sources if r.get("key") in set(services)]
        requested_keys = services[:]

    # If caller requested explicit services but none exist (should be prevented by unknown check),
    # still keep NOT_FOUND as per description for "none ... exist".
    if services is not None and not targets:
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "None of the requested services exist")

    # ---- Create sync job ----
    now = _now()
    job_id = _ulid()
    job = {
        "id": job_id,
        "job_type": "service_sync",
        "requested_source_id": None,
        "requested_keys": requested_keys,
        "force": bool(force),
        "status": "queued",
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "result_summary": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    sync_jobs.append(job)
    _save("sync_jobs.json", sync_jobs)

    # Transition queued -> running
    job["status"] = "running"
    job["started_at"] = _now()
    job["updated_at"] = job["started_at"]
    _save("sync_jobs.json", sync_jobs)

    # ---- Perform "sync" (offline: update metadata + optionally touch files idempotently) ----
    # Since we cannot fetch upstream, we model effects as:
    # - If force=True: mark relevant doc_files as 'stale' to indicate re-index needed.
    # - Update doc_sources.last_synced_at and latest_synced_commit (deterministic synthetic ref).
    # - Respect lifecycle: allow active/disabled/error sources; don't change status unless error constraints violated.
    per_service = []
    files_touched = 0
    sources_synced = 0

    # helper: lifecycle transitions for doc_sources
    allowed_transitions = {
        "active": {"disabled", "error"},
        "disabled": {"active"},
        "error": {"active", "disabled"},
    }

    # Index doc_files by source_id
    files_by_source = {}
    for f in doc_files:
        sid = f.get("source_id")
        if sid:
            files_by_source.setdefault(sid, []).append(f)

    try:
        for src in targets:
            sid = src.get("id")
            skey = src.get("key")
            prev_commit = src.get("latest_synced_commit")
            prev_synced = src.get("last_synced_at")

            # Determine whether to "skip" (idempotent behavior) when not forced:
            # If already synced before and not in error -> skip.
            will_skip = (not force) and (prev_synced is not None) and (src.get("status") in ("active", "disabled"))
            if will_skip:
                per_service.append(
                    {
                        "service": skey,
                        "source_id": sid,
                        "status": "skipped",
                        "last_synced_at": prev_synced,
                        "latest_synced_commit": prev_commit,
                    }
                )
                continue

            # If in error status, we can "recover" only if we can satisfy constraints:
            # setting status to active requires last_error null if not error.
            # We'll set status active and clear last_error.
            if src.get("status") == "error":
                # Transition error -> active allowed
                if "active" not in allowed_transitions.get("error", set()):
                    per_service.append(
                        {"service": skey, "source_id": sid, "status": "error", "error": "INVALID_TRANSITION"}
                    )
                    continue
                src["status"] = "active"
                src["last_error"] = None

            # Update sync metadata
            new_synced_at = _now()
            # Synthetic commit ref: sha256(service_key + synced_at) truncated
            synthetic = hashlib.sha256((str(skey) + "|" + new_synced_at).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
            src["latest_synced_commit"] = synthetic
            src["last_synced_at"] = new_synced_at
            src["updated_at"] = new_synced_at

            # If force, mark files stale (legal transition active->stale/error->stale)
            if force and sid in files_by_source:
                for f in files_by_source[sid]:
                    st = f.get("status")
                    # only attempt transitions when meaningful
                    if st in ("active", "error"):
                        # active/error -> stale is allowed per schema
                        f["status"] = "stale"
                        f["updated_at"] = new_synced_at
                        files_touched += 1

            sources_synced += 1
            per_service.append(
                {
                    "service": skey,
                    "source_id": sid,
                    "status": "updated",
                    "last_synced_at": src.get("last_synced_at"),
                    "latest_synced_commit": src.get("latest_synced_commit"),
                    "files_marked_stale": files_touched if force else 0,
                }
            )

        # Persist doc_sources and doc_files updates
        _save("doc_sources.json", doc_sources)
        _save("doc_files.json", doc_files)

        # Finish job succeeded
        job["status"] = "succeeded"
        job["finished_at"] = _now()
        job["updated_at"] = job["finished_at"]
        job["result_summary"] = {
            "sources_targeted": len(targets),
            "sources_synced": sources_synced,
            "files_marked_stale": files_touched if force else 0,
            "force": bool(force),
        }
        _save("sync_jobs.json", sync_jobs)

        elapsed_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        return {
            "job": {
                "id": job["id"],
                "status": job["status"],
                "job_type": job["job_type"],
                "force": job["force"],
                "requested_keys": job["requested_keys"],
                "started_at": job["started_at"],
                "finished_at": job["finished_at"],
                "result_summary": job["result_summary"],
            },
            "results": per_service,
            "execution_ms": elapsed_ms,
        }
    except Exception as e:
        # Finish job failed with message, preserving "unexpected conditions return an error object"
        job["status"] = "failed"
        job["finished_at"] = _now()
        job["updated_at"] = job["finished_at"]
        job["error_message"] = str(e) or "Sync failed"
        _save("sync_jobs.json", sync_jobs)
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Sync job failed", job_id=job_id, error_message=job["error_message"])

tool_schemas.name: list_laravel_services
tool_schemas.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of external Laravel services known to the system, optionally filtered by status and/or key and sorted by the requested field; the response includes up to limit items and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid status/sort/order, out-of-range limit, or malformed cursor, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view service sources.

key.description: Filter by service key (e.g., forge, vapor, envoy, nova).

limit.description: Maximum number of services to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: search_external_laravel_docs
tool_schemas.description: Executes a full-text search over cached external Laravel service documentation for the given query, optionally restricted to the provided service keys, and returns matching documents/sections with relevance ordering. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty or any service key is unknown, NOT_FOUND if none of the requested services exist in the catalog, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to search, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when search rate limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get_laravel_service_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed metadata for a single external Laravel service (key, display name, source status, and sync/search availability details). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if service is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the service key is not recognized, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view service details.

metadata.name: Laravel MCP Companion
metadata.description: This backend stores a locally-synced cache of official Laravel framework documentation (by version) and supported external Laravel service documentation (Forge/Vapor/Envoyer/Nova, etc.), plus an indexed search layer with query logs. Main workflows are: sync/update docs from upstream sources into ver
